decisions.reason: The firm has shown its strongest visible commitment to this close-to-core line by giving it its own page in both 2023 and 2024, so management would be inclined to justify that investment and continue it.

As a close fit with the established skincare range that remained on the website across both years, this serum is likely to be seen as worth retaining because the commitment is still public and any weaker performance can be read as temporary.
Because this product disappeared from the website by 2024, the public commitment now looks weak and management has less reason to escalate further, making withdrawal the more likely choice.

Since this cleansing oil was launched only in 2024 and sits close to the core offer, management would typically continue it in 2025 because the investment is recent and disappointing early results can still be attributed to launch-phase effects.
